claim: All five known ordinary-polytopal H9/14 nerves admit exact full-domain factor-supported Coxeter label families satisfying every finite-vertex and Lanner-minimal-nonface constraint.  Every member of all five families is globally non-Lorentzian, so a genuine candidate requires cross-factor non-right coupling.  The unrestricted minimum counts are 4,2,1,1,1 for records 30,42,43,44,47.

finite_label_domain.larger_label_exclusion: Burcroff Lemma 10.10 excludes multi-multiple edges m>=6 for a compact 9-polytope with 14 facets.

proof_summary.global: Orthogonal Lanner-bearing blocks force negative index at least two; record 30 has inertia exactly (9,5,0).  More generally, minimal-nonface components give unrestricted cross-edge lower bounds 4,2,1,1,1.

proof_summary.symmetry: Full minimal-nonface-hypergraph automorphism groups and exact orbit traversal; complete only within each stated sparse ansatz.
